STEP 1 - Scene: A breakfast or snack bowl/plate of mixed fruit (raspberries, blackberries, red grapes), crispy bacon or candied bacon pieces, chia seed pudding or chia-topped portion, and white cubes that look like soft cheese or tofu-like curd.

STEP 2 - Vessel: A large white square-ish plate, roughly 26 cm across. Area = 3.14 x (13)^2 ≈ 531 cm². Food covers most of the central plate; the small white crumbs on the table at left are outside the plate and excluded.

STEP 3 - Items: raspberries, blackberries, red grapes, bacon pieces (cooked, some candied), chia seed pudding/mass, white soft cheese cubes.

STEP 4 - Area (percent of vessel, ~531 cm²):
- Raspberries 14% = 74 cm² x 1.5 cm = 111 ml x 0.6 = 67 g
- Blackberries 6% = 32 cm² x 1.5 cm = 48 ml x 0.6 = 29 g
- Red grapes 8% = 42 cm² x 1.5 cm = 64 ml x 0.6 = 38 g
- Bacon pieces 12% = 64 cm² x 1 cm = 64 ml x 0.9 = 58 g
- Chia pudding 10% = 53 cm² x 1.2 cm = 64 ml x 1.0 = 64 g
- White cheese cubes 8% = 42 cm² x 1 cm = 42 ml x 0.9 = 38 g

Covered share ≈ 58% of vessel, consistent with the visible scatter.

STEP 5-6: Gross volume ≈ 371 ml; grams as listed, total ≈ 294 g.

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Raspberries 67 g x 52 kcal/100g = 35 kcal
- Blackberries 29 g x 43 = 12 kcal
- Grapes 38 g x 69 = 26 kcal
- Bacon 58 g x 450 (cooked, some candied) = 261 kcal
- Chia pudding 64 g x 150 (chia pudding with milk) = 96 kcal
- Cheese cubes 38 g x 300 = 114 kcal
Total ≈ 544 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: About 290 g of mixed fruit, bacon, chia and cheese covering most of a dinner-size plate is plausible; bacon and cheese dominate the energy. Estimate is roughly 294 g and 540 kcal, with uncertainty of ±30%.
